randomization.method: randomized point order in each of three waves; randomized near-balanced Latin rotations within paired four-arm blocks

shared_contract.denominator: all offered source audio/frontiers, including misses

endpoints: actual Consumer audio-frontier rollback and deficit area
primary.interaction: Y11-Y10-Y01+Y00 per point and timing repeat; keep all 9 paired blocks
primary.mechanism: complete witnessed compatible/incompatible ahead updates and actual critical-path stages; no posthoc time-shift or idealized replay
primary.unit: 16 reused development sources nested at 8/16; three timing replicates are not three independent audio samples
primary.decision: describe measured operating region, natural convergence and miss causes; failure does not authorize more parameter search or relaxed deadlines

hypotheses: c8-sync should contain few compatible-ahead opportunities and arms may converge
c8-staggered changes batch formation/host synchronization and probes the observed D2 boundary
c16-staggered increases concurrency and may fail D2; extra preservation cannot fix all overload
before_results.adaptive_extension: none without a separately stated scientific reason and a new frozen plan
before_results.source_selection: original metadata order first8 and all16

required_prelaunch: no-argument local repository preflight; clean source/full byte manifest; full commit locally resolvable; idle GPU; environment/config/raw/summary/decision records before first model call

old_development_basis.basis: dev_v3 actual Qwen R1_S1 cells only; raw critical-path recount is a separate artifact
